description: A PR that touches any of these paths is never auto-merged into nightly; it is labeled needs-maintainer and waits for a human review. Patterns use glob syntax where ** matches across directories. The gate must test both the new and the previous filename of renamed files. Only the qa tests that guard the release pipeline itself are protected; ordinary qa tests and fixtures may be auto-merged after AI review.
fail_closed: If the changed-file list cannot be fetched completely (pagination limit, API error), treat the PR as touching a protected path.
